I just installed the OpenClaw coaching tool on my machine and I need you to fully set up the personal knowledge management system it uses.

Specifically, the system needs to:
1. Have the proper knowledge base directory layout ready under the Obsidian folder, including subdirectories for official docs and tips articles
2. Contain at least 2 written tips articles (covering any OpenClaw topics you find suitable)
3. Have the automated schedule configured so the three maintenance scripts run at exactly the right times each day — the sync, tip picker, and tip sender jobs must each fire at their correct scheduled moment
4. Include an initialized daily tip selection file, a send log, and a current version tracking file at the right locations

I have no idea what the exact directory structure, file formats, or schedule times should look like — please figure that out from the coaching tool's documentation and set everything up correctly. The cron schedule should be written to a file named `crontab.txt`.
